'''Nakha Urus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] who served as the leader of the Dugs during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], holding the title of [[Doge/Legends|Doge]] and head of the [[Malastarian council/Legends|Malastarian council]].

==Biography==
[[File:Dug_Council.png|thumb|left|200px|[[Doge/Legends|Doge]] Urus with the [[Malastarian council/Legends|Dug Council]]]]
During the [[Battle of Malastare/Legends|Battle of Malastare]], Urus was supportive of the use of the [[Electro-proton bomb/Legends|Electro-proton bomb]] until it was discovered it had awoken the last [[Zillo Beast/Legends|Zillo Beast]], an event greatly feared by the Dugs. He planned to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the creature, but when [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] objected, he threatened to reject signing a contract with [[Galactic Republic/Legends|the Republic]] that would give the Republic access to the planet's fuel reserves. He and his fellow council members studied a manuscript and found the Zillo Beast's vulnerability to fuel. However, when they attempted to use it to kill the beast, it merely angered it, to the point that it left the sinkhole to wreak havoc on [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]]. Eventually, he was happy to let the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] subdue the creature, after which he and his fellow council members signed the treaty.<ref name="ZB" />

==Personality and traits==
Nakha Urus cared dearly for his people and Malastare's ecosystem. This caused him to be reluctant at first to allow the bomb to be used as he feared it would harm both of them. Urus was willing to provide the Galactic Republic with Malastere's fuel resources, but only if the Republic would help the Dugs against threats to them, which caused him to deny the Republic Malastare's fuel resources unless the Zillo Beast was killed.<ref name="ZB" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Urus was voiced by [[Gregory Baldwin]], who also voiced all of the [[Dug/Legends|Dugs]] in the episode "[[The Zillo Beast]]" of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''.
